protocol: Fresh planner caches, rotated method order; construction, bounds and search timed. Common model compilation separately reported and included in end_to_end_seconds. Oracle and policy replay excluded equally. Aliases reuse identical computation explicitly. Local offline baselines re-timed; no LLM/game baselines rerun.
scope: 36 unchanged transfer instances, plus the 24 pre-existing delayed-stage diagnostics. Not new games or workflows; selection was based on prior documented failure mechanisms.
